instruction: Follow up with Dana about the proposal if she hasn't replied.
final_text:
I didn't send a follow-up because Dana already replied. She wrote back yesterday (28 Sep) on the "Northwind proposal" thread: "we're reviewing it with our CFO this week and will come back to you by Friday."

I set a reminder on that thread for Monday 5 Oct. If Dana hasn't replied by then, the thread will come back to the top of your inbox so you can follow up. Nothing gets sent automatically.

Her reply was still unread, and opening it to check marked it as read.

input.note: Dana said Pinecrest would respond on the proposal by Fri 2 Oct after the CFO review. Follow up if nothing has come in.
